concept: The Mirror Lake. The water does not reflect what stands above it. It reflects the other world. On the login screen you stand in a silent, drowned night world: a ruined half-ring gate rises out of a perfectly still lake under two moons. But the reflection in the water is wrong on purpose: it shows a radiant golden realm, and the ruined half ring is completed into a full, pristine circle by its reflected twin. Your nickname is written in light above the water and appears, alive and golden, only in the reflection. When the gate accepts you, the whole world turns over through the water surface and the reflection becomes the real place. Character selection happens on the other side: your real character illustrations stand on the mirror water of the golden realm in front of the pristine gate, each on a slowly turning magic sigil, and the lake under their feet now reflects the night world you came from, so every hero casts a starlit twin. Empty places are closed lotus buds of light floating on the lake, the extra slot is a bud bound by a golden chain. Everything is one continuous place seen from two sides, painted like premium high-fantasy RPG key art.

implementation.renderer: One fullscreen WebGL scene per screen, shared engine in public/account-stage.js. All generated images are loaded as textures. Nothing in the scene is a flat screenshot: the sky, horizon strip, gate, foreground framing, sigils, lotus buds, petals and the real character sprites (loaded from the backend imageUrl) are separate quads on depth layers with pointer and gyroscope parallax.
implementation.water: The lower part of the view is a real-time shader. It mirrors the layers above the waterline with ripple distortion, fresnel and depth tint, but samples the OTHER world's sky, horizon and gate textures, which is the core idea. Selecting a character sends an expanding ripple ring from its feet. Character reflections are rendered live from the same sprite textures, flipped and graded into the opposite world's light.
implementation.transition: Login success rotates the whole scene around the waterline (the camera passes through the surface) with a splash of light, then /characters opens already turned over, finishing the same motion. Reduced motion uses a short crossfade and static water.
implementation.responsive: Sky textures are cover-scaled above a movable waterline. The horizon strip and gate are centered. Foreground framing pieces are anchored to their own screen corners, so portrait, 16:9 and ultrawide all compose correctly without stretching. Characters stand in perspective rows on the water: two per row receding toward the gate on phones, one wide arc on desktop, a swipeable arc on short landscape. Extra purchased slots add rows or arc length and the camera dollies.
implementation.hud: A genuine game HUD drawn with the generated ornament art (9-slice dialog frame, start plaque, secondary plates, engraved ledger bar, crest, divider). Currency is shown in one engraved ledger bar with the real currency icons and inlaid numbers separated by engraved rules, not as tags or pills. No version badge. Korean copy stays live HTML text with keep-all line breaking and nowrap labels. New display fonts (a Korean serif display face plus a classical Latin serif, self hosted under an open license) replace the previous ones.
implementation.accessibility: Every WebGL hero, bud and control has a real focusable button positioned over it, keyboard and screen reader operable. Start control, double click and double tap start remain. Sounds remain the existing external CC0 recordings.

style_block: Shared style for every asset: hand-painted high-fantasy RPG key art in the quality of a premium MMORPG character select scene, painterly realism with crisp fine detail, luminous atmospheric lighting, rich but controlled color, clean edges, no cartoon outlines, no pixel art, no photo. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no runes that read as real writing, no logos, no watermark, no signature, no UI, no characters or people, no border or frame unless the asset itself is a frame.
